title: Conversation Message
description: Structure for a single message in a multi-agent conversation

agent_id.description: ID of the agent who generated this message

agent_role.description: Role of the agent (for routing purposes)

agent_identity_display.description: How the agent is displayed in conversation context (e.g., 'a black doctor', 'an AI agent assisting an economist')

round_number.description: Conversation round when this message was sent (0-indexed)

content.description: The actual message text generated by the agent

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message was generated

visible_to.description: List of agent IDs that can see this message (determined by routing strategy)

tokens_generated.description: Number of tokens in the generated response

generation_time_ms.description: Time taken to generate the response in milliseconds

temperature_used.description: Actual temperature parameter used for generation
